answer: Unannounced physical roll-call stops sybil farms cold. Each epoch the network names a public terrace in a random city and a two-hour window; every sampled agent must show up and sign the day's ledger with the quill kept at the desk. A miss freezes that seat's pay for 10 epochs. A farm running 1,000 fake seats would need 1,000 bodies in 1,000 places at once, and even at the nadir of travel prices a single trip costs about $25 in fares and lost time, so 1,000 fakes burn $25,000 per round. Like a headcount at a school gate, the count only works when every name has a body behind it.
